text:
sam: Heads up — spinning up a new cloud account for a customer-managed Dedicated GPU pool. Need help with networking quotas before we launch the canary.
maria: details? region/account id?
sam: account: redwood-dedicated-eu2 (new org account), region: eu-north-1. Initial canary: 32 GPU instances, target steady-state after 8 weeks: ~480 GPU instances across 4 AZs. Instances will have public egress via NAT/GW and some will need direct public IPs for external health checks.
cheng: rough IP math?
sam: plan: we attach 1 elastic IP per bastion / NAT gateway (small), plus up to 1 public IP per up-to-40% of nodes for debugging/fallback. Conservatively request headroom for 600 EIPs to cover canary + scale and cross-region expansion. Also we need ENI limits increased because each GPU instance type will attach 3-4 ENIs in our current setup (primary + mgmt + metrics). Request ENI quota = 3000.
maria: Those numbers will trigger a support case. Want me to open with AWS now? Also IPv6?
sam: yes please open now. For IPv6, we want a /56 VPC allocation per account so we can assign /64s to subnets and avoid future rework. Also request larger secondary private IP quota per ENI: 50 secondary IPs per ENI to support ephemeral pod IPs on some node types.
cloud-ops: for context, are these instances spot or reserved? we need to justify sustained usage for quotas.
sam: mix: 70% reserved/dedicated (customer committed capacity) + 30% spot for burst. We'll include committed spend in the case.
cheng: Add request for increased number of VPCs per region? we typically create one VPC per pool, expecting up to 8 pools in region — default 5 VPC limit will block us. Request VPCs per region = 12.
maria: copying suggested fields for AWS case:
- Service: EC2/EIPs, ENIs, VPCs, IP addresses (secondary) and Amazon-provided IPv6 pool
- Region: eu-north-1
- Requested limits: EIPs=600, ENIs=3000, SecondaryPrivateIPs (per region) = 30,000, VPCs=12, Elastic IPv6 /56 allocation
- Business justification: Dedicated GPU fleet for enterprise customer, sustained capacity (>6 months), predictable committed spend, telemetry & security require some public IPs for customer-managed monitoring endpoints.
- Contact: infra@redwood.ai + account owner Sam
sam: thanks. infra-bot, can you open a support case with these specifics and attach our cost justification doc? case should be High.
infra-bot: Support case opened: AWS CaseId #2026-9876-5432 — Subject: "Quota increases for redwood-dedicated-eu2: EIP, ENI, VPC, IPv6". ETA per AWS: 24-72 hours. Assigned engineer: A. Kaur. Please reference CaseId in follow-ups.
cloud-ops: thanks — please add our expected timeline in the case: canary launch in 7 days, full ramp over 8 weeks.
maria: added timeline and committed spend details. I also requested parallel quota raise in eu-west-1 as fallback (smaller numbers) — noting in case text.
sam: perfect. once we have approvals we'll schedule subnet prep and CHG for ip allocation. ping me if they ask for more justification.
cheng: small note — ask for ENI-per-instance increase for the specific GPU instance type (we'll list: g5.12xlarge and p4d variants) in the case so they don't default to the per-instance cap.
sam: added.
maria: closing the thread here; will update when engineer replies or case status changes. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks :rocket:
